decisions.reason: It extends the firm’s proven recycling-system platform and shows a strong customer value signal, so under real-options logic it is worth keeping unless it is later folded into the flagship modular line.

As a close-to-core machine that remained on its own page across two years, it likely has manageable holding costs and still merits staying on the market while demand information continues to accumulate.
This flagship modular product line fits the firm’s strategic direction and already shows concrete customer adoption and large savings, making abandonment very unlikely.
This newly launched close-to-core shredder line should be retained because uncertainty is still high, the firm is growing, and the option value of learning from the market remains attractive.
Although newer and somewhat more uncertain than the firm’s core machines, this screen line supports the modular environmental-technology strategy and is still too early to abandon.
